TOWERDEFENSE_MOWER_DEFAULT_HANDBOOK_EXPR: Ability: [color=cc241d]Clears one row of all non-boss zombies. No additional effect.[/color]
TOWERDEFENSE_MOWER_DEFAULT_HANDBOOK_STOR: Your trusty yard mower, slightly modified to handle zombie cleanup.
TOWERDEFENSE_MOWER_SUN_EXPRESTION: Earn sun by running over zombies!
TOWERDEFENSE_MOWER_SUN_HANDBOOK_EXPRESTI:
[color=FF0000]How to Obtain[/color]: [color=0000cd]Purchase "Sun Mower" from the Shop[/color]

Ability: [color=cc241d]Replaces the Lawn Mower. Each zombie it runs over drops 25 sun.
TOWERDEFENSE_MOWER_SUN_HANDBOOK_STORY: The mower filed for this emergency reserve of sun on your behalf. Then again, you could always scrap the mower and use it as starting capital.
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_CAPTAIN_EXPRESTION: Fires coins and calls in airborne reinforcements when you remove a plant!
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_CAPTAIN_HANDBOOK_EXP:
[color=FF0000]How to Obtain[/color]: [color=0000cd]Clear Adventure Mode 7-4[/color]

Ability: [color=cc241d]
① When digging up a plant that costs less than 500 sun, fires 1 silver coin and summons 1 hypnotized Pirate Crew Zombie from above for every 100 sun of its cost.

② When digging up a plant that costs at least 500 sun, fires 1 gold coin for every 300 sun of its cost and summons 1 hypnotized Pirate Captain Zombie from above for every 500 sun of its cost.[/color]
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_CAPTAIN_HANDBOOK_STO: Supposedly forged from a pirate ship's golden anchor... Those pirates must think every plant you dig up is buried treasure.
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_COLD_EXPRESTION: Fires Snow Peas forward when you remove a plant!
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_COLD_HANDBOOK_EXPRES:
[color=FF0000]How to Obtain[/color]: [color=0000cd]Clear Adventure Mode 2-4[/color]

Ability: [color=cc241d]When digging up a plant, fires Snow Peas equal to 10% of that plant's sun cost, rounded down.[/color]
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_COLD_HANDBOOK_STORY: They say this shovel came from an ice-cream stand.
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_DEFAULT_HANDBOOK_STO: A little shovel from Crazy Dave! With so many powerful new shovels around, maybe this one has earned a vacation.
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_DIAMOND_EXPRESTION: Refunds a large amount of sun when you remove a plant!
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_DIAMOND_HANDBOOK_EXP:
[color=FF0000]How to Obtain[/color]: [color=0000cd]Purchase "Diamond Shovel" from the Shop[/color]

Ability: [color=cc241d]Refunds 30% of a plant's sun cost when you dig it up.[/color]
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_DIAMOND_HANDBOOK_STO: Just look at that crystalline finish. Surely it wasn't crafted from one diamond and two sticks... right?
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_GOLD_EXPRESTION: Refunds a small amount of sun when you remove a plant!
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_GOLD_HANDBOOK_EXPRES:
[color=FF0000]How to Obtain[/color]: [color=0000cd]Clear Adventure Mode 1-4[/color]

Ability: [color=cc241d]Refunds 20% of a plant's sun cost when you dig it up.[/color]
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_GOLD_HANDBOOK_STORY: A golden shovel found on the lawn. It looks like solid gold, but it is surprisingly durable—probably just gold-plated.
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_JALAPENO_EXPRESTION: Unleashes a full row of fire when you remove a plant!
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_JALAPENO_HANDBOOK_EX:
[color=FF0000]How to Obtain[/color]: [color=0000cd]Clear Adventure Mode 3-4[/color]

Ability: [color=cc241d]When digging up a plant, scorches the entire row and deals fire damage equal to that plant's sun cost to every zombie in the row. Digging up a zero-cost plant does not trigger this effect.[/color]
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_JALAPENO_HANDBOOK_ST: One red-hot shovel. It even keeps your hands warm in winter.
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_MAGNET_EXPRESTION: Pulls metal objects from the lawn when you remove a plant!
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_MAGNET_HANDBOOK_EXPR:
[color=FF0000]How to Obtain[/color]: [color=0000cd]Clear Adventure Mode 4-4[/color]

Ability: [color=cc241d]When digging up a plant, creates a magnetic vortex that pulls in and destroys metal objects carried by zombies anywhere on the lawn, prioritizing the nearest targets. It removes 1 object for every 75 sun of the plant's cost, rounded down.[/color]
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_MAGNET_HANDBOOK_STOR: It is really just one enormous electromagnet. Where does the electricity come from? Solar power, of course!
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_MELON_EXPRESTION: Fires melons forward when you remove a plant!
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_MELON_HANDBOOK_EXPRE:
[color=FF0000]How to Obtain[/color]: [color=0000cd]Clear Adventure Mode 5-4[/color]

Ability: [color=cc241d]When digging up a plant, fires 1 melon forward for every 20 sun of that plant's cost.[/color]
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_MELON_HANDBOOK_STORY: You reap what you sow? With this shovel, anything you sow yields melons!
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_PUMPKIN_EXPRESTION: Creates a Pumpkin when you remove a plant, or grants sun when you remove a Pumpkin!
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_PUMPKIN_HANDBOOK_EXP:
[color=FF0000]How to Obtain[/color]: [color=0000cd]Clear Adventure Mode 6-4[/color]

Ability: [color=cc241d]
① Digging up a non-Pumpkin plant creates a Pumpkin that inherits the removed plant's current health. If the tile already has a Pumpkin, that Pumpkin gains health equal to the removed plant's current health.
② Digging up a Pumpkin grants sun equal to its current-health percentage multiplied by 50% of the Pumpkin's sun cost.[/color]
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_PUMPKIN_HANDBOOK_STO: The center of the blade seems hollow. Put a candle in there and it might double as a jack-o'-lantern.
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_SKELETON_EXPRESTION:
Randomly revives an allied zombie when you remove a plant!
It can also dig skeletons straight out of their pits!
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_SKELETON_HANDBOOK_EX:
[color=FF0000]How to Obtain[/color]: [color=0000cd]Clear Adventure Mode 8-4[/color]

Ability: [color=cc241d]
① Digs up a plant and revives one random fallen hypnotized zombie. The revived zombie's health equals 5 times the removed plant's sun cost.
② Can dig up a Skeleton Pit to summon its Skeleton Zombies early.[/color]
TOWERDEFENSE_SHOVEL_SKELETON_HANDBOOK_ST: Said to be a forbidden relic haunted by necromantic power. Whoever wields it... well, actually, it is just a movie prop from Chomper's House of Horrors.
